description: A luxury beachfront hotel offering world-class amenities and exceptional service.

dining.name: Ocean Breeze Restaurant
dining.description: Elegant restaurant featuring fresh seafood and international cuisine.

dining.name: Sunset Bar
dining.description: Beachfront bar with signature cocktails and live music on weekends.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in. Late cancellations or no-shows will be charged one night's stay.
policies.pets: Pets are allowed with prior notification. Additional fee of $50 per night per pet applies.
policies.smoking: This is a non-smoking property. Designated smoking areas are available outdoors.
policies.children: Children of all ages are welcome. Kids under 12 stay free when using existing bedding.
policies.payment: We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, and cash. Full payment or valid credit card required at check-in.
policies.extra_bed: Extra beds available upon request for $35 per night.

nearby_attractions.name: South Beach
nearby_attractions.description: Famous beach with white sand and vibrant atmosphere

contact_hours: Our front desk is available 24/7 for your convenience.

faq.question: Do you offer airport transportation?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer airport shuttle service for an additional fee of $35 per person one-way. Please let us know your flight details in advance.

faq.question: Is breakfast included?
faq.answer: Breakfast is not included in the standard room rate but can be added for $25 per person per day. Our restaurant serves breakfast from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Do you have parking?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer valet parking for $35 per day or self-parking for $25 per day.

faq.question: Is WiFi free?
faq.answer: Yes, complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the property for all guests.
